name: Hanan (son of Midian)
title: Son of Midian, descendant of Abraham
summary: Hanok was one of the sons of Midian, and thus a descendant of Abraham through Keturah. He is mentioned in the genealogy of Keturah's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of Midian
keyEvents.description: Hanok is listed among the sons of Midian in the genealogy of Abraham's descendants through Keturah.
